description: Time freezes when trying to kick a villager out of a bed then breaking it i have attatched a video of the glitch and the log for that session it still loads chunks. Here is a video with the bug The game can also randomly freeze.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Place a bed in the world.
3. Summon a villager next to the bed using the command `/summon minecraft:villager ~ ~ ~`.
4. Use the bed while the villager is sleeping on it, causing the villager to be kicked out of the bed.
5. Immediately break the bed after kicking the villager out.
6. Observe that the game freezes and time stops progressing.
7. Note that you can still load chunks but cannot interact with any other blocks or entities.
8. Record the freeze state for further documentation.
Observed Behavior: The game can randomly freeze when attempting to kick a villager out of a bed and then breaking the bed. This issue causes time to freeze, preventing any further interactions within the world. The bug can be consistently reproduced by waking up a villager that is sleeping in a bed, quickly breaking the bed before the villager can recline, and then observing the subsequent freeze. During this freeze, players are unable to interact with blocks such as chests or workbenches, and mobs become unresponsive. Additionally, chunks continue to load, but no items drop when breaking blocks, and the game cannot be saved or closed normally without resorting to Task Manager to force-close it. A video demonstrating the glitch has been attached along with a session log for further reference.
Expected Behavior: When trying to kick a villager out of a bed and then breaking the bed, the game should not freeze. Time should continue to progress normally, and the villager should be kicked out of the bed, allowing the player to break it without any issues. The world should remain fully interactive, with no freezes or lag, and all entities and blocks should function as expected.
